title: Meta launches Muse Wonder and Muse Wonder Full, its most capable AI models yet
description: Meta started a ground-up overhaul of its AI efforts 14 months ago, and the first result was Muse Spark, which the company used to lay out its approach to "predictable, rigorous scaling". Now, Meta has taken what it calls "the next step" on its "scaling ladder" with the Muse Wonder series, made up of Muse Wonder and Muse Wonder Full. Meta says these are its most capable models, delivering "state-of-the-art performance on personal and professional agentic tasks". They were trained at the company's gigawatt-scale Prometheus data center, and they accept text, image, video, and audio as input...

title: Apple Home Collection launches with LG and Schneider cameras, thermostats, and sensors
description: Apple had a busy day today. The company introduced its HomeView smart display, the next-generation Apple TV 4K, and the HomePod mini 2, all with Siri AI. Alongside those, it also announced the Apple Home Collection, a range of smart home accessories co-developed with LG Electronics and Schneider Electric. The lineup includes four LG cameras, an LG smart lock, two smart thermostats (one each from LG and Schneider Electric), and a temperature sensor from each of the two companies. Every device is set up with a single tap of an iPhone and controlled entirely from the Home app or with Siri, so...

title: Apple announces HomeView with a 7-inch touchscreen and Siri with Apple Intelligence
description: Apple today announced the HomeView, the company's upcoming smart home hub powered by the new Siri. It will be available in desktop and wall-mounted designs and will be available next month. The standard HomeView model features a floating display design with a rounded aluminum base. The display is hinged and is tilt-adjustable. It will be available in four colors: silver, starlight, rose pink, and space gray, each with a matching cable. The wall-mounted model only features the display module and will offer a choice of different mounts from Schneider Home. It will only be...

title: The new Apple TV 4K uses the A19 chipset and supports Siri AI, but the price tag is killer
description: Apple’s big smart home event is in full swing and among all the new gadgets is the Apple TV 4K (4th gen). We’ll start by ripping off the band-aid – the new model costs double the launch price of the 3rd gen model from 2022 (and that’s if you look at the 128GB model with Ethernet!). There is some good news, at least – the new model is massively more capable than the one it replaces. It is powered by the Apple A19 chipset, the one inside the iPhone 17. The performance uplift from the A15 chip inside the 2022 model is massive – the CPU is 50% faster and the GPU is 2x faster. More...

title: AnTuTu September ranking is out, Xiaomi leads in flagships and tablets categories
description: Continuing its tradition, AnTuTu has published data that shows which devices topped its performance charts in the flagship, mid-range, and tablet categories. The numbers are for September and are based on data collected in China. Moreover, the AnTuTu 12 benchmark scores included in its charts are averages of those devices, not peak scores. In the flagship category, Xiaomi topped the chart with the Xiaomi 18 Fold, which has an average score of 4,620,886 and is powered by the XRing O3. The Xiaomi 18 Fold is followed by the iQOO 16 and Honor Magic9 Pro Max, both powered by the Snapdragon 8...

title: Realme and OnePlus also reveal their ColorOS 17 rollout schedules
description: Oppo just announced the global rollout of ColorOS 17. The official schedule sees the first updates arriving on October 29. Due to recent restructuring, both Realme and OnePlus also use ColorOS on their phones – here is when they will receive the new version. First up are the GT 8 Pro (and its Dream Edition version), the OnePlus 15 and the OnePlus Pad 4. Realme GT 8 Pro • OnePlus 15 • OnePlus Pad 4 Then on October 30, OnePlus will round off its 2025 and 2024 premium models, while Realme takes care of the GT 7 Pro and the first of the Realme 16 series. Realme GT 7...

title: Here's when the Oppo Find X10 series is launching in India
description: The Oppo Find X10 and Find X10 Pro Max, which launched in China last month, are set to go global on October 21. Oppo has now confirmed when the phones will arrive in India. In a post on X, Oppo India confirmed that the Find X10 series will launch in India on October 22, a day after its global debut. Both the global and Indian markets will get only the Find X10 and Find X10 Pro Max, while the Find X10 E will remain exclusive to China. The Find X10 features two 200MP rear cameras, while the Find X10 Pro Max is the first flagship to offer a triple 200MP rear camera setup. Both...

title: ColorOS 17 starts its global rollout next week, here is the full schedule
description: ColorOS 17 made its debut with the Find X10 Pro Max series in China and now it is ready to follow the phones as they set off on their global journey – the global launch for the Find X10 and Find X10 Pro Max is scheduled for October 21 (Wednesday next week). Obviously, the X10 models will come with v17 out of the box. Now, here’s when older Oppo phones will get the new ColorOS version. About a week after the X10 generation goes live, Oppo will start rolling out ColorOS 17 for the X9 series and the N6 foldable. October 29 Oppo Find N6 • Oppo Find X9 Ultra • Oppo Find...

title: vivo V80 and X Fold6 are now on sale in India
description: The vivo V80 and X Fold6, launched in India last week, are now on sale through vivo's Indian website, Amazon.in, Flipkart, and partner retail stores. The vivo V80 comes in Sunrise Anthem, Horizon Blue, and Stellar Black colors. All have three memory options - 8GB/128GB, 8GB/256GB, and 8GB/512GB, priced at INR62,999, INR69,999, and INR79,999, respectively. vivo V80's color options The vivo X Fold6, on the other hand, comes in Nebula Teal and Prism Black in one memory configuration, 12GB/512GB, priced at INR219,999. It also supports a telephoto extender, but vivo didn't launch...

title: Watch the ColorOS 17 launch event livestream
description: Oppo's Android 17-based ColorOS 17 is scheduled to be unveiled globally today. The latest mobile operating system will be available for Oppo and OnePlus devices. If you’re interested in watching the launch event live, you can do so via the embedded YouTube player below. The ColorOS 17 update will bring several UI changes with updated visuals and smoother animation. It is also teased to include glass-like design elements. Oppo has also noted that the update will bring several new smart AI features. The Find X10 series, which is going global on October 21, will come with the latest...

title: Honor Win2 and Win2 RT complete design and colors revealed, Win Turbo2 will tag along
description: After recently teasing the phones’ rear panel, Honor has now confirmed that the Win 2 series will include a Win Turbo 2 variant. Honor also revealed their complete designs, colors, and configurations. The lineup is set to launch in China on October 21. The Honor Win2 will get an active cooling fan, a dual-rear camera setup, and will be available in Red and Blue Buff, Black, and White color options. It will be offered in 12GB/256GB, 12GB/512GB, 16GB/256GB, 16GB/512GB, and 16GB/1TB variants. Honor hasn’t revealed any specifications of the handset, but rumors suggest that the...

title: Samsung and Apple were the winners in a Q3 smartphone market that dropped 20%
description: Counterpoint Research (CR) has just published its report regarding the global smartphone market for the third quarter of the year (July to September). And it was a terrible one. Shipments dropped 20% compared to Q3 2025. The only winners in terms of growing their market shares were Samsung and Apple. Samsung led the pack with a 23% market share (compared to 19% in the year-ago quarter), while Apple was a close second with 22% (up from 18% in Q3 2025). They were followed by Xiaomi with 10% of the pie (down from 14%), Oppo with 9% (down from 12%), and vivo with 8% (down from 9%). CR...

title: Google's new Fitbit Edge fitness tracker offers a screen and up to 7 days of usage
description: Google has unveiled its latest fitness tracker, the Fitbit Edge. Positioned between the Pixel Watch 5 and the Fitbit Air, the new tracker offers a more affordable and lighter alternative to the smartwatch while adding a display over the screenless Fitbit Air. The Fitbit Edge sports a 1.34-inch AMOLED display with always-on functionality. The tracker measures 11.5mm in thickness and features an aluminum case that weighs 17.7 grams without the band. A physical button on the right side of the case lets users navigate the interface. Unlike the Pixel Watch 5, the Fitbit Edge does not run...

title: Main specs leak for Oppo's upcoming wide Reno X
description: For a while now, Oppo has been rumored to be working on a wide candybar smartphone, a genre reinvented by the Huawei Pura X View recently. According to past leaks, Oppo's entrant into this space will be called Reno X. Today, a tipster on X has purportedly shared its main specs. The device allegedly has a 6.35-inch flat screen with a 120Hz refresh rate and a 16:9 or 16:10 aspect ratio (for reference, note that the Pura X View has a 5:3 aspect ratio, which sits in between 16:9 and 16:10). The Reno X will be powered by an unspecified MediaTek Dimensity 9000-series chipset, and it will...

title: WhatsApp starts testing scheduled messages
description: WhatsApp has allegedly spent months developing a feature that will let you schedule messages, and this is now finally being made available to a limited number of users who are part of the beta program for WhatsApp on the Google Play Store for Android. As you might expect, it lets you schedule messages to be delivered at a specific date and time. It works both for one-on-one chats and group chats. The messages you schedule will be delivered at the time you set even if your device is offline then. Message scheduling currently supports text, links, photos, and videos, though you can only...

title: Nothing Phone (3) is now receiving the update to Nothing OS 5.0 based on Android 17
description: Nothing started its open beta program for Nothing OS 5.0 based on Android 17 back in late August, and today the company is finally ready to roll out the new OS version to everyone. Well, everyone who owns a Nothing Phone (3), that is. [#InlinePriceWidget,13969,1#] The rollout has started, but it is staggered, so "availability may vary by region and device", the company says in its official announcement post. title: Google adds new Metal Mesh bands for the Fitbit Air in two colors
description: Google unveiled the Fitbit Edge today, but it also announced an update for the Fitbit Air. Namely, it revealed that it's making available two new Metal Mesh bands for the screen-less fitness tracker. Metal Mesh bands for the Fitbit Air in Champagne Gold (left) and Polished Silver (right) According to the company, these "turn your tracker into a piece of jewelry designed to be worn day to night". title: JP Morgan: demand for iPhone 18 Pro models is stronger than for the 17 Pro models last year
description: Analysts are sending mixed signals – sales of the iPhone 18 Pro models in China are stronger than those of the 17 Pro models and yet Apple is reportedly cutting component orders due to weak demand. The analysts at JP Morgan are saying that there’s nothing to worry about. In a note to investors, the analysts say that the production cut is a fairly typical adjustment for Apple after a big iPhone launch. They blame it on the split launch – Apple launched the iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone 18 Pro Max in September and will launch the non-Pro models early next year. The note from JP Morgan confirms...

title: One UI 9 for the Galaxy S24 series, Galaxy Z Fold6 and Flip6 reaches the US
description: Last week, Samsung's One UI 9 rollout reached the Galaxy S24 series as well as the Galaxy Z Fold6 and Flip6, but, as usual, the company started it in South Korea. Now, a few days later, the update is also available in the US. Galaxy S24 devices purchased from both AT&T and T-Mobile are starting to receive the update in the US. The update comes over-the-air as an almost 4GB download, so make sure you grab it over a fast enough network. Once you install it, you will be on One UI 9 based on Android 17, and you will also have the September 2026 security patch level. For the S24 models, the new...

title: Huawei may be launching a new phone sub-brand, here is what it will be called
description: When Huawei was put under trade restrictions by the US, it was no longer able to use Android for its phones – at least not the version offered by Google. Eventually, the company settled on a split strategy – Huawei proper would focus on its in-house HarmonyOS and Kirin chipsets while the Honor sub-brand would be spun off and continue with Android (and it retained access to Qualcomm and MediaTek chips).
